title: Rochester trio, first Social Security card, joining the union
summary: He takes a trio job in Rochester, Minnesota, gets his first Social Security card, and returns to St. Paul where he has to join the union.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: So I had to cut out from that band. I went with a trio down to Rochester, Minnesota, where the Mayo Clinic is. We went down there, and that's when they brought in Social Security... I guess I went around '36 or '37, or '38 maybe. The guy started collecting Social Security. So we didn't understand what the fuck they meant. In fact, I didn't know what Social Security meant. In fact, for me it was just like somebody was taking my money, you know. So we had to go through with it, because we had to finish the job, and so we stayed until the job was over. And that's where I got my first Social Security card.

Then the next thing I know, we was back in St. Paul, and I had to join the union, because I had a pretty nice little job playing up there -- I can't think of the name of the club to save my soul. Some joint out there. Aw, what the heck is it? I've been trying to think of the name of that club, and I can't think of it.
I hope so. It ain't come to me in years, man. I've been trying to figure out what's the name of this
The only one I ever heard of, I think, was later, but I don't know how it was going...was the Nest. There was a place called the Nest that they talk about.

No, it wasn't that. It was some joint up there. Anyway, I had to join the union. I (?) with that, because I couldn't see what I was joining the union for. I'd been working all the time anyway, you know.
